meaning:
μαίνομαι
[in LXX: Jer.25:16 (הָלַל hith.) Jer.29:26 (שָׁגַע pu.), Wis.14:28, a). ;]
1. to rage, be furious.
2. to rave, be mad: Jhn.10:29, Act.12:15 26:24-25, 1Co.14:23 (cf. ἐμ-μαίνομαι).†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: You are out of your mind
you are out of your minds
